top_authentic_signals.name: Temporal Coherence
top_authentic_signals.summary: The audio contains no spoken words, consisting only of an acoustic guitar intro followed by a dramatic human gasp. The gasp sounds entirely natural and free of synthetic artifacts, indicating it is an authentic human recording.
top_authentic_signals.what_found: The video review did not find the usual temporal tells: motion stays coherent, details remain stable, and scene geometry holds across frames.
top_authentic_signals.why_it_matters: AI video generators often fail across time even when individual frames look convincing.
top_authentic_signals.caveat: Low bitrate, motion blur, and heavy compression can resemble temporal artifacts, so this signal is weighed with the rest of the evidence.

top_authentic_signals.name: Audio Track
top_authentic_signals.summary: Embedded video audio: This audio appears to be authentic human speech. Confidence: 50%. Inference via hf space.
top_authentic_signals.what_found: The model classified this audio as a authentic human voice with 50% certainty. Probability real: 50% | Probability fake: 50%.
top_authentic_signals.why_it_matters: AI voice cloning is increasingly used to fabricate statements by public figures. This check catches spectral artifacts in the audio that TTS models leave behind.
top_authentic_signals.caveat: The model was fine-tuned on 6 TTS engines. Novel cloning systems not in its training set may evade detection. Short clips (<2.5 s) or heavily compressed audio may reduce accuracy.

top_authentic_signals.summary: The audio contains no spoken words, consisting only of an acoustic guitar intro followed by a dramatic human gasp. The gasp sounds entirely natural and free of synthetic artifacts, indicating it is an authentic human recording.
top_authentic_signals.what_found: The video review did not find the usual temporal tells: motion stays coherent, details remain stable, and scene geometry holds across frames.
top_authentic_signals.why_it_matters: AI video generators often slip across time. Stable footage is meaningful support for a real recording, not just an absence of evidence.
top_authentic_signals.caveat: This detector is useful, but it can still be wrong and should be treated as one part of the full picture.

The compression stress is consistent across all four quadrants, and only 0.00% of pixels show elevated residuals. This uniform profile suggests the image has a consistent compression history - no obvious signs of region-level editing or compositing.
top_inconclusive_signals.why_it_matters: A uniform ELA profile removes one red flag - there are no obvious editing seams. However, ELA does not tell us whether the image is AI-generated, only that it has not been obviously composited. The other detectors handle the AI vs. real question.
top_inconclusive_signals.caveat: ELA detects editing and compression inconsistency, not AI generation. Social media uploads, repeated saves, and WhatsApp forwarding all degrade this test. It's treated as a weak supporting check.
